paragraphs.text: Heartwood is a predefined token and artifact type that is introduced in the upcoming Reality Fracture set. It is the first predefined artifact token , and second predefined token overall (after Walker ), to have a color .
A Heartwood token is a red and green artifact with " : Add or ." Heartwood tokens are useful not only for ramping up your available mana but also the number of artifacts you control.

Note that the Heartwood token included in the initial print run of Reality Fracture used the colorless artifact frame, leaving no indication the token has the colors on the token itself. This issue does not affect gameplay, as the token is just a representation of the game object and will be treated as regardless. A statement in the " Reality Fracture Mechanics" article implied that later print runs of the token will correct this issue.
The Heartwood used to be a location on Rath . The Heartwood Shard was a relic found on Mirrodin .

In the Echoverse , Aerid Konstrari mastered the ability to animate inert materials by condensing leyline energy into a heartwood crystal, and passed this knowledge on to the Konstrari cadets of Hexhaven .
